\[
2\sin 46^\circ = 2\sin(30^\circ+16^\circ)
=2\left(\frac12\cos16^\circ+\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\sin16^\circ\right)
=\cos16^\circ+\sqrt3\sin16^\circ
\]

Thus the numerator is
\[
\cos16^\circ+\sqrt3\sin16^\circ-\sqrt3\sin16^\circ=\cos16^\circ
\]

So the expression equals
\[
\frac{\cos16^\circ}{\cos16^\circ}=1
\]

\boxed{1}
